title: Aerial Hammock Basic - 10 Beginner Tricks | aerial practice

method.teacher_system: The teacher first warms up on the mat with lunges and leg lifts, then demonstrates ten basic beginner aerial hammock tricks sequentially, and finally performs a flowing routine combining the tricks to music.
method.signature: Demonstrating a full flow performance at the end of the tutorial that strings all the taught beginner tricks together to music.

practices.what: Performs floor stretches and warm-up exercises on a mat before using the aerial hammock.
Breaks down ten individual beginner aerial hammock tricks step by step from standing and hanging positions.
Performs a complete dance flow utilizing the learned tricks combined smoothly with music.

struggles.theme: Zero upper body strength and finding aerial work difficult

clicked.theme: Videos are easy to follow and actually for beginners
